title: Toast
description: Global toast host component. Mount once near the app root. Imperative API: showToast(message, type?, duration?) exported from the module script.

showToast.description: Enqueues a toast notification that auto-dismisses after duration ms.

params.name: message
params.description: Text shown in the toast body.

params.name: duration
params.description: Display time in milliseconds before auto-close.
